test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.**

Biosphere reserves are 'learning places for **__sustainable__** development'.
solution:
The correct answer is **"maintainable."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word** "sustainable"** means that something can continue or be continued for a long time. (जो देर तक बना रहे या क़ायम रखा जा सके)

 
 
• Example: *That sort of extreme diet is not **sustainable**__ over a long period.*
 
 
 
• The appropriate synonym for the underlined word is "maintainable."
 
• The word "maintainable" means something that can be easily sustained, supported, or kept in a certain condition over time without excessive effort or difficulty. (कुछ ऐसा जिसे अत्यधिक प्रयास या कठिनाई के बिना आसानी से बनाए रखा जा सकता है, समर्थित किया जा सकता है, या समय के साथ एक निश्चित स्थिति में रखा जा सकता है)
 __
 
• Example: *The new software was designed with **maintainable**__ code.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Brief: **short or quick. (संक्षिप्‍त या अल्‍पकालिक)
 
• **Temporary: **lasting for a short time; not permanent. (अल्‍पकालिक, अस्‍थायी)
 
• **Unsuitable: **not right or appropriate for somebody/something. ((किसी व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु के लिए) अनुपयुक्त या जो सही न हो)
